name: Love Island: All Stars
description: Some of your favourite Islanders from across the years heading back to the stunning South African villa to once again 'graft' as their search for love continues.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Maya Jama is a shoulder to cry on as a group of Love Island All Stars return to paradise for the first time ever... ALL hoping that they can find romance the second time around.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As the flirtfest continues, everyone wants to talk to Mollie, but Jake struggles to find his place in the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Islanders are getting on - Mitch says he is still deciding between two girls, and Chris and Luis are both in dilemmas. Jake makes an announcement, and is a kiss on the cards?

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Someone's keen to find weird ways to kiss, meanwhile it's getting hard for one girl to watch Luis explore connections with others. But Day 3 is too early to get jealous, right?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The recoupling causes crazy tensions in the group, and one raging Islander storms around swearing a lot. The next morning, there's a big kiss reveal... Plus, news of a Bombshell!

videos.title: Unseen Bits #1
videos.overview: It's the first Unseen Bits and, boyyy, there's a lot to see. There's talk of "hotboxing", hair falling out, some, er, unpronounceable words, and one very fetching mustard tank top.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: No girl is safe with the arrival of new Bombshell Arabella, especially as most of the boys seem to think they're still single. And what's the history with Toby and Arabella?!

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Sparks are flying between Callum and one beauty, plus Georgia H needs headspace - could there be trouble in paradise? Oh, and is that Maya back in the Villa with huge shock twist?!

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: It's a day for big chats, a barney over Georgia S, and a long walk to the terrace. Plus, some very daring balloon action. Steamy snog, anyone?!

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: So after Hannah made quite the impression on Tyler, could they be getting on on another level? And let's just say there's double trouble with the arrival of TWO new Bombshells...

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Bombshell Sophie's arrival is causing one guy's head to spin. Tune in to witness some secret hand holding, a bro code getting broken (or is it?), and a SHOCK text arriving.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Chris is toying with his emotions biiig time, there's talk about love languages, and Sophie's stuck in the middle. Plus, someone plans to be brutal in a twisty Truth or Dare game.

videos.title: Unseen Bits #2
videos.overview: It's that time again - all the naughtiest, funniest and unbelievable unseen bits from the Love Island All Stars.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: It's getting hot out here! There’s a game of Truth or Dare between Tom and Georgia S, two lovers head to the hideaway, and two more prepare for a first date. Turn up the steam!

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Sadly, it's time for two former lovebirds to call it a day, but it does mean one of them can make a move on one of the other Islanders! And who's ready for some Snog, Marry, Pie?

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Josh and Chris become detectives as they uncover a revelation, Molly feels like a total mug, and Maya makes a surprise show to share some news - but what are the consequences?!

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: The Islanders now have a SUPER important decision to make. As decisions are being made around the firepit, who arrives but... hang on, is this another Bombshell?!

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Two Islanders decide to rehash their history, but has their ship sailed? There's a ghostly game of Never Have I Ever and a very rocky recoupling around the firepit.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The recoupling has sent shockwaves through the Villa - Arabella has an emotional reaction, but where does it leave Toby? Meanwhile, it's time for a girly cocktails and convos!

videos.title: Unseen Bits #3
videos.overview: You think you've seen it all - well, guess what, there's MORE goss. Strap in for another jam-packed edition of exclusive unseen moments from the nation's favourite Villa.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Callum’s frustrated - just give the man some answers! Two former lovers rekindle their connection, plus it’s time for an ALL-STAR awards ceremony!

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The fallout from The PDAs rumbles through the Villa. Plus: is one girl a risk taker? Can she and a potential new lover get away with secret shenanigans on the terrace?!

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Bring on the games as anything could happen with three blonde Bombshells stepping into the Villa - with NONE of them holding back! Plus: is someone hot for Molly?!

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: It’s time for the Islanders to get glam because there's a special performance coming up... Plus: who's the guy with the jokey personality who's being a bit too much of a showman?

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: One lucky couple is getting a treat tonight, but who will it be?! While we're thinking about couples, which do you think has the least sexual chemistry?! Oh, and hi there, Maya!

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: As the Islanders face a dumping, opinions and accusations are flying all over the place. Still, there's good news for two lovebirds. And is that a door opening with a new face?!

videos.title: Unseen bits #4
videos.overview: What'll it be? Just another Saturday, or a rollercoaster ride of hot goss, shock chats, saucy snogs and more in this week's offering of Unseen Bits? We know which one we want!

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: After Arabella’s whirlwind couple of hours, what's next in store for her? A Villa party pops off in more ways than one for one couple. Plus: Molly receives a surprise text...

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: What's all this?! A Breakfast Double Date for two loved-up couples - but are there more twists to come?! Plus: it’s time for one of the most anticipated challenges of the series...

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: After a hearty challenge ruffles more than a few feathers, Molly has questions. And talking of questions, who do you think is the hottest couple in the Villa?

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: There's only one question weighing on Toby right now. It's also time for two Islanders to face some hard opinions head on. Plus: who's toasting marshmallows around the fire pit?!

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Someone's in the friendship doghouse - because, let's face it, there is such a thing as being too honest... Meanwhile, the girls are VERY excited and can't believe their luck.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: After an emotional day, the girls are riding high following their calls back home. Well, except Molly's got some hot words for someone later on. And the big finale is approaching!

videos.title: Unseen Bits #5
videos.overview: They flirted, they argued, they fell in love and quickly out of it again, and now it's your chance to see the last Unseen Bits of the series before the Grand Finale. Get in!

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: After a turbulent 24 hours, Anton needs someone to confide in - who will he reach out to? Then, in an epic turn of events, there's a Love Island first as... ooh, what, what?!

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: On the final day, the vibes are high as the Islanders receive some mega news. Plus: for the first time ever, five All Star couples will battle it out for the £50k. Who will win?!

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: After a sizzling second week in paradise, not one of our All Star Islanders wants to leave the Villa behind right now when there is up to 50,000 pounds to be won.

videos.overview: The final fast approaches and the drama in the Villa continues as some couples don't see eye to eye and it's time for the Islanders to perform in the All Star Talent Show.

videos.overview: Get ready, everyone - it's time for another jam-packed edition of exclusive unseen moments from everyone's favourite villa. With gossip, drama, flirting and romance galore, we'll be bringing you all the best unseen action here.

videos.overview: The fallout continues from Villa USA's arrival, Millie suggests a trip to the Hideaway Retreat, and Tommy has a bone to pick with Sean after his Lucinda decision.

videos.overview: Expect surprise kisses, shock proposals and messy pies from a game of Snog, Marry, Pie with a twist, and there's triangle trouble for Sher, Scott and Leanne.

videos.overview: The Heart Rate Challenge results are in and Jessy has the boys' pulses racing, Harrison gets to know Sher while Jessy is keen to get to know Zac and Tommy, and Storm Belle has entered the chat with Scott and Leanne caught in the whirlwind.

videos.overview: The Islanders are tested in a game of Knowing Me, Knowing You!, and from graft to grand gesture, Sean plans to impress Lucinda with some help - will his romantic scheming with Tommy and Carrington pay off, and how will Lucinda react?

videos.overview: Whitney and Yamen uncork their feelings on a vineyard date, the favourite couple results are in before a second shock text rocks the Villa, and Sean and Lucinda's declaration sparks reactions with Scott weighing in and Leanne lamenting labels.
